title: China-Nepal floods: 261 foreigners listed missing in Tibet, cyber police target rumours

article.title: China-Nepal floods: 261 foreigners listed missing in Tibet, cyber police target rumours
article.summary: China said on Sunday that 261 foreign citizens were missing after last week’s deadly floods along the border between its Tibet autonomous region and Nepal. The missing foreigners were from 23 different countries and included 104 Nepalese citizens, authorities in Tibet’s Gyirong county told reporters. Also unaccounted for are 49 people from India; 33 Latvians; 18 from the United States; 15 from Britain; six each from Canada and Australia; four from South Africa; three each from Malaysia, Germany...
